definition: Something that is hard to do or understand; a problem.
examples: He has difficulty reading small print.
We had some difficulties with the car.
She walked with difficulty after the fall.

spanish.definition: Algo difícil de hacer o entender; un problema.

definition: The art or the job of taking pictures.
examples: I took a photography class.
Her hobby is photography.
He studied nature photography.

spanish.definition: Arte o trabajo de tomar fotos.

definition: A machine that cleans floors by pulling up dirt; to clean with this machine.
examples: I vacuum the living room every week.
The vacuum is in the closet.
Can you vacuum the stairs?

spanish.definition: Máquina que limpia pisos jalando la suciedad; limpiar con ella.

definition: A person who lives in a place.
examples: The residents of this building are very friendly.
She's a resident of Miami.
Parking is only for residents.

spanish.definition: Persona que vive en un lugar.

definition: To accept something painful for a long time.
examples: She endured years of pain.
He couldn't endure the cold.
They endured a long trip in the heat.

spanish.definition: Aceptar algo doloroso por mucho tiempo.

definition: A solid, liquid or gas of a certain kind.
examples: There's a sticky substance on the floor.
This substance is dangerous for children.
The police found an illegal substance.

spanish.definition: Sólido, líquido o gas de cierto tipo.

definition: Dishonest and using power to get money.
examples: The mayor is corrupt.
They arrested a corrupt police officer.
People are tired of corrupt politicians.

spanish.definition: Deshonesto y que usa el poder para conseguir dinero.

definition: A person who tries to find out the facts about a crime or a problem.
examples: She hired a private investigator.
The investigators found a new clue.
He's an investigator for the police.

spanish.definition: Persona que busca los hechos de un crimen o problema.

definition: A large organization, such as a bank or a university.
examples: Harvard is a famous institution.
She works for a financial institution.
The hospital is a respected institution.

spanish.definition: Organización grande, como un banco o universidad.

definition: A small church or a room for praying.
examples: They got married in a little chapel.
The hospital has a chapel.
We prayed in the chapel.

spanish.definition: Iglesia pequeña o cuarto para rezar.

definition: A person who can't stop drinking alcohol; containing alcohol.
examples: His father was an alcoholic.
She doesn't drink alcoholic beverages.
He's a recovering alcoholic.

spanish.definition: Persona que no puede dejar de beber alcohol; que contiene alcohol.

definition: Something that people in a place usually do; made for one person.
examples: It's a custom to take off your shoes here.
We learned about local customs.
He ordered a custom suit.

spanish.definition: Algo que suele hacer la gente de un lugar; hecho para una persona.

definition: Money paid regularly to someone who has stopped working because of age.
examples: My grandfather lives on his pension.
She gets a good pension from the state.
He lost his pension when the company closed.

spanish.definition: Dinero pagado con regularidad a quien dejó de trabajar por la edad.

definition: A person who can't stop using something, like a drug.
examples: He's a drug addict.
I'm a coffee addict.
The center helps addicts get better.

spanish.definition: Persona que no puede dejar de usar algo, como una droga.

definition: An important part of something; to include as an important part.
examples: This phone has a lot of new features.
Her eyes are her best feature.
The movie features a famous actor.

spanish.definition: Parte importante de algo; incluir como parte importante.

definition: Very pleasant.
examples: We had a delightful evening.
She's a delightful person.
What a delightful little town!

spanish.definition: Muy agradable.

definition: A sport in which two people try to throw each other to the ground.
examples: He joined the wrestling team.
My son loves watching wrestling on TV.
She won a medal in wrestling.

spanish.definition: Deporte en que dos personas tratan de tirarse al suelo.

definition: To make something smaller or less.
examples: We need to reduce our costs.
The store reduced its prices.
Exercise can reduce stress.

spanish.definition: Hacer algo más pequeño o menor.

definition: A person whose job is to keep records of money.
examples: My accountant does my taxes.
She works as an accountant for a bank.
We need to hire an accountant.

spanish.definition: Persona cuyo trabajo es llevar registros de dinero.

definition: A mass of cells growing in the body that should not be there.
examples: The doctors removed the tumor.
He has a brain tumor.
Luckily, the tumor was small.

spanish.definition: Masa de células que crece en el cuerpo y no debería estar ahí.

definition: Working by itself, without a person.
examples: The store has automatic doors.
I drive an automatic car.
Payment is automatic every month.

spanish.definition: Que funciona solo, sin una persona.

definition: Funny and enjoyable.
examples: He told an amusing story.
I find this very amusing.
It's an amusing little book.

spanish.definition: Gracioso y agradable.

definition: Not needed.
examples: Don't buy unnecessary things.
That comment was unnecessary.
We should avoid unnecessary risks.

spanish.definition: Que no se necesita.

definition: A large place with seats for watching sports.
examples: The stadium was full for the game.
We drove to the football stadium.
The new stadium holds sixty thousand people.

spanish.definition: Lugar grande con asientos para ver deportes.

definition: Able to be seen.
examples: The mountain is visible from here.
The stars were clearly visible.
There's no visible damage to the car.

spanish.definition: Que se puede ver.

definition: Not knowing about something.
examples: I'm ignorant about cars.
He made an ignorant comment.
Many people are ignorant of the danger.

spanish.definition: Que no sabe sobre algo.

definition: A serious promise; to promise seriously.
examples: He made a pledge to stop smoking.
They pledged money to the school.
Students say the Pledge of Allegiance.

spanish.definition: Promesa seria; prometer con seriedad.

definition: A chair with wheels for people who can't walk.
examples: My grandmother uses a wheelchair.
He pushed her wheelchair down the hall.
The building has a wheelchair ramp.

spanish.definition: Silla con ruedas para personas que no pueden caminar.

definition: The work of keeping something in good condition.
examples: The car needs regular maintenance.
Call maintenance about the broken light.
He works in building maintenance.

spanish.definition: Trabajo de mantener algo en buen estado.

definition: A plant whose leaves are used in cigarettes.
examples: Tobacco is bad for your health.
They grow tobacco in Virginia.
The store doesn't sell tobacco.

spanish.definition: Planta cuyas hojas se usan en los cigarrillos.

definition: Below the surface of the water.
examples: He can swim underwater for a minute.
She took underwater photos of the fish.
The whole street was underwater.

spanish.definition: Debajo de la superficie del agua.

definition: To separate into parts; to find how many times a number goes into another.
examples: Divide the cake into eight pieces.
Ten divided by two is five.
The teacher divided the class into groups.

spanish.definition: Separar en partes; calcular cuántas veces cabe un número en otro.

definition: A lower price than usual.
examples: Students get a ten percent discount.
Can you give me a discount?
I bought it at a discount.

spanish.definition: Precio más bajo de lo normal.

definition: Exercises for the body and mind that come from India.
examples: I do yoga every morning.
She teaches yoga at the gym.
Yoga helps me relax.

spanish.definition: Ejercicios para el cuerpo y la mente que vienen de la India.

definition: Not talking much about your own success; not large.
examples: He's very modest about his work.
They live in a modest house.
She got a modest pay raise.

spanish.definition: Que habla poco de su propio éxito; no muy grande.

definition: A small hard seed, like rice or wheat; a very small piece.
examples: Eat more whole grains.
There's a grain of sand in my shoe.
Farmers store the grain for the winter.

spanish.definition: Semilla pequeña y dura, como arroz o trigo; pedacito muy pequeño.

definition: In the most important ways; basically.
examples: The two phones are essentially the same.
It's essentially a good idea.
He's essentially a shy person.

spanish.definition: En lo más importante; básicamente.

definition: Not easy to notice.
examples: There's a subtle difference between the two colors.
This soup has a subtle flavor.
She gave me a subtle hint.

spanish.definition: Que no es fácil de notar.

definition: A strong thin rope; a wire covered in plastic.
examples: The phone cord is too short.
He tied the box with a cord.
Unplug the cord from the wall.

spanish.definition: Soga delgada y fuerte; alambre cubierto de plástico.

definition: The place or the moment where something starts.
examples: What's the origin of this word?
She's of Mexican origin.
Nobody knows the origin of the fire.

spanish.definition: Lugar o momento en que algo empieza.

definition: Dishonest behavior by people in power.
examples: People are angry about government corruption.
The police are investigating corruption in the city.
He went to prison for corruption.

spanish.definition: Comportamiento deshonesto de personas con poder.

definition: To remove writing or information.
examples: She erased the board.
I accidentally erased the file.
Can you erase that word?

spanish.definition: Quitar algo escrito o información.

definition: The taste of something.
examples: What's your favorite ice cream flavor?
This soup has a lot of flavor.
Garlic adds flavor to the dish.

spanish.definition: El gusto de algo.

definition: A large sea animal with big claws that you can eat.
examples: We ate lobster in Maine.
Lobster is expensive in this restaurant.
The lobster turned red in the pot.

spanish.definition: Animal grande de mar con pinzas que se puede comer.

definition: A long man-made river for boats.
examples: Ships cross the Panama Canal.
We took a boat down the canal.
There's a path along the canal.

spanish.definition: Río largo hecho por personas para barcos.

definition: An area with no direct sun; a light or dark type of a color.
examples: Let's sit in the shade.
I want a darker shade of blue.
The big tree gives us shade.

spanish.definition: Lugar sin sol directo; variedad de un color.

definition: Wanting very much to be successful.
examples: She's a young and ambitious lawyer.
That's a very ambitious plan.
He's too ambitious to stay in this job.

spanish.definition: Que quiere mucho tener éxito.

definition: A large group of people who play music together.
examples: She plays violin in an orchestra.
The orchestra played for two hours.
We went to hear the city orchestra.

spanish.definition: Grupo grande de personas que tocan música juntas.

definition: Help and advice.
examples: Students need guidance from their teachers.
Thank you for your guidance.
She went to a guidance counselor.

spanish.definition: Ayuda y consejo.

definition: Certain to happen.
examples: Change is inevitable.
An argument was inevitable.
It's inevitable that prices will go up.

spanish.definition: Que seguro va a pasar.

definition: A person or a team you compete against.
examples: The two companies are rivals.
We beat our biggest rival.
He's my rival for the job.

spanish.definition: Persona o equipo contra el que compites.

definition: To buy something; something that you buy.
examples: You can purchase tickets online.
She purchased a new car.
Keep the receipt for your purchase.

spanish.definition: Adquirir algo pagando; algo que compras.

definition: To walk around slowly with no special purpose.
examples: We wandered around the old town.
Don't wander off in the store.
He wandered through the park.

spanish.definition: Caminar despacio sin un fin especial.

definition: The richest or most powerful people in a group; among the best.
examples: He went to an elite private school.
Only the elite can pay those prices.
She's an elite athlete.

spanish.definition: Las personas más ricas o poderosas de un grupo; entre los mejores.

definition: An activity in which you make things by hand.
examples: The kids did arts and crafts.
She sells her crafts at the market.
He learned the craft from his father.

spanish.definition: Actividad en la que haces cosas a mano.

definition: A picture that shows information.
examples: Look at the chart on page five.
The song is at the top of the charts.
She made a chart of the monthly sales.

spanish.definition: Imagen que muestra información.

definition: The daughter of your son or daughter.
examples: She takes her granddaughter to the park.
My granddaughter is four years old.
He bought a gift for his granddaughter.

spanish.definition: La hija de tu hijo o hija.

definition: To give something to someone for a decision.
examples: Submit your application by Friday.
I submitted my homework online.
She submitted the report to her boss.

spanish.definition: Dar algo a alguien para una decisión.

definition: A person who watches and directs workers.
examples: I talked to my supervisor about the schedule.
She's the supervisor of the night shift.
Can I speak to your supervisor?

spanish.definition: Persona que vigila y dirige a los trabajadores.

definition: A great success.
examples: The show was a triumph.
She returned home in triumph.
It was a triumph of science.

spanish.definition: Gran éxito.

definition: How often something happens; the number of a radio signal.
examples: Doctors are worried about the frequency of his headaches.
Storms are coming with greater frequency.
Change the radio frequency.

spanish.definition: Qué tan seguido pasa algo; número de una señal de radio.

definition: A paper that lists your education and work experience.
examples: Send your resume to the manager.
I updated my resume last week.
Her resume looks very good.

spanish.definition: Papel con tu educación y experiencia de trabajo.

definition: To take someone's attention away from something.
examples: Don't distract me while I'm driving.
The noise distracted the students.
He tried to distract the dog with food.

spanish.definition: Quitarle a alguien la atención de algo.

definition: A feeling of being pleased with something.
examples: She gets a lot of satisfaction from her job.
Customer satisfaction is important.
He smiled with satisfaction.

spanish.definition: Sentimiento de estar contento con algo.

definition: Connected to the past.
examples: I enjoy historical novels.
This is a historical building.
We visited many historical places.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con el pasado.

definition: Having a strong taste like a lemon.
examples: These grapes are sour.
The milk has gone sour.
I like sour candy.

spanish.definition: Que tiene un sabor fuerte como el limón.

definition: A very small piece of fire.
examples: A spark from the fire burned my shirt.
Sparks flew from the machine.
One spark can start a forest fire.

spanish.definition: Pedacito muy pequeño de fuego.

definition: The world; a round map of the world.
examples: People from all over the globe visit Paris.
There's a globe on the teacher's desk.
She found Peru on the globe.

spanish.definition: El mundo; mapa redondo del mundo.

definition: The top of a mountain; the highest point of something.
examples: We could see the snowy peaks.
She's at the peak of her career.
Traffic is worst at peak hours.

spanish.definition: Cima de una montaña; punto más alto de algo.

definition: Very strong or violent.
examples: The tiger is a fierce animal.
There was a fierce storm last night.
The two companies are in fierce competition.

spanish.definition: Muy fuerte o violento.

definition: A dishonest plan to get money.
examples: That email is a scam.
He lost his savings in a scam.
Be careful of phone scams.

spanish.definition: Plan deshonesto para conseguir dinero.

definition: Having an empty space inside.
examples: The tree is hollow.
This chocolate rabbit is hollow.
The wall sounds hollow.

spanish.definition: Que tiene un espacio vacío adentro.

definition: The act of giving all your attention to something.
examples: This work requires a lot of concentration.
The noise broke my concentration.
He lost his concentration and missed the ball.

spanish.definition: Acción de dar toda tu atención a algo.

definition: To put money into something to make more money.
examples: She invested in a small company.
We should invest in our children's education.
He invests his money in real estate.

spanish.definition: Poner dinero en algo para ganar más dinero.

definition: Very new and different; having extreme political ideas.
examples: The company needs radical changes.
He has radical political opinions.
It's a radical idea.

spanish.definition: Muy nuevo y diferente; con ideas políticas extremas.

definition: Wanting to keep someone safe; made to keep you safe.
examples: She's very protective of her kids.
Workers must wear protective clothing.
He's a protective older brother.

spanish.definition: Que quiere mantener a alguien seguro; hecho para protegerte.

definition: Upset because you can't do what you want.
examples: I'm frustrated with this computer.
He got frustrated and left.
She felt frustrated at work.

spanish.definition: Molesto porque no puedes hacer lo que quieres.

definition: To love someone or something very much.
examples: She adores her grandchildren.
I adore this city.
The kids adore their teacher.

spanish.definition: Amar mucho a alguien o algo.

definition: A person who designs buildings.
examples: She's an architect in Chicago.
The architect showed us the plans.
He wants to be an architect.

spanish.definition: Persona que diseña edificios.

definition: To keep something in its original state.
examples: We need to preserve the forest.
Salt helps preserve meat.
They preserved the old church.

spanish.definition: Mantener algo en su estado original.

definition: The amount of medicine that you take at one time.
examples: Take one dose every six hours.
The doctor gave her a high dose.
Don't miss a dose.

spanish.definition: Cantidad de medicina que tomas de una vez.

definition: A piece of kitchen equipment for cooking food.
examples: The soup is on the stove.
Did you turn off the stove?
We have a gas stove.

spanish.definition: Aparato de cocina para cocinar alimentos.

definition: A home for children whose parents are dead.
examples: She grew up in an orphanage.
They adopted a boy from an orphanage.
We gave toys to the local orphanage.

spanish.definition: Hogar para niños cuyos padres murieron.

definition: The name of a famous person, written by that person.
examples: Can I have your autograph?
He got the singer's autograph.
She collects autographs of baseball players.

spanish.definition: Nombre de una persona famosa escrito por ella.

definition: A group of people who meet; the act of putting parts together.
examples: The school assembly is at nine.
Some assembly is required for this desk.
He works on an assembly line.

spanish.definition: Grupo de personas reunidas; acción de unir partes.

definition: All the clothes that a person has; a tall cabinet for clothes.
examples: She needs a new summer wardrobe.
Put your coat in the wardrobe.
His wardrobe is mostly black.

spanish.definition: Toda la ropa de una persona; mueble alto para ropa.

definition: The amount you can hold in one hand; a small number.
examples: He ate a handful of nuts.
Only a handful of people came.
She picked up a handful of sand.

spanish.definition: Cantidad que cabe en una mano; número pequeño.

definition: A large round orange vegetable.
examples: We carved a pumpkin for Halloween.
My mother makes great pumpkin pie.
There are big pumpkins at the farm.

spanish.definition: Verdura grande, redonda y anaranjada.

definition: A heavy metal object that keeps a ship in one place; a person who reads the TV news.
examples: They dropped the anchor near the island.
She's a news anchor in Atlanta.
The ship pulled up its anchor.

spanish.definition: Objeto pesado de metal que sujeta un barco; persona que lee las noticias.

definition: Feeling happy about something good; grateful.
examples: I'm thankful for my family.
We're thankful that nobody was hurt.
Be thankful for what you have.

spanish.definition: Contento por algo bueno.

definition: The inside of something.
examples: The car has a leather interior.
She's an interior designer.
The interior of the church is beautiful.

spanish.definition: La parte de adentro de algo.

definition: A soft red fruit used in salads and sauces.
examples: Add a tomato to the salad.
I grow tomatoes in my yard.
Do you want tomato sauce on your pasta?

spanish.definition: Fruto rojo y suave usado en ensaladas y salsas.
